text_block_list.text: After going out today, I plan to hang out with Eishin Flash and Tosen Jordan.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
So, what're we doing today?
I haven't heard a plan... Did you come totally unprepared?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Not at all.
Today, I have plans to make things look 'Insta-worthy' at a café.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Huh? "Insta-worthy"?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, seriously.
This place is totally an Instagrammable cafe for real.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: "Man... who would've thought Flash-san would invite me for 'Insta-worthy' sweets?"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: To think that Flash, who got so depressed over "karaoke for now"... would do this... huh...?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...What is it?
Please state whatever you wish to say clearly.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... Nothin' much?
Just thought I'd take a pic to commemorate my first 'Insta-worthy' moment.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Is that also part of the new culture?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Yup yup. I'm on the cutting edge of fashion, after all.
I'm just really in the mood to take photos right now.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...No. Please join us, Trainer.
This photo is a memento for all of us.
(Snap)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much
for keeping me company today.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: "I had assumed "Insta-worthy" was just about taking photos, so it turned out to be much livelier than I expected. In addition—"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...It was most amusing.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: To think that simply taking a group photo could make my heart flutter so much... Honestly, it's quite a surprise.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Doesn't that mean you've gotten used to it enough to actually enjoy the trends...?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Familiarity... no.
If I were to describe this feeling—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: I should say... I've grown accustomed to it.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
There is still much I do not know,
but I have learned the joy of discovering it.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"Above all, I have someone reassuring
by my side."
choice_data_list: Let's keep learning from now on.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Ehh~~... Wow, that's so emotional.
It really hit me right in the feels."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Huh... 'Emo'?
No sooner had you spoken than an unrecognized word appeared.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...Assuming this will happen frequently in the future,
it seems we ought to implement measures for greater efficiency."
choice_data_list: All we can do is keep building it up step by step.
Maybe we should ban German for a while or something.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
That's true. Jordan-san did say
it was cutting-edge, after all.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Jordan-san.
Please, allow me to learn from you.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Based on the patterns of the conversations we've had,
I believe I will be able to input it all
if we spend about six days together.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ......Are you being for real?
A few days later...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"Trainer, do something about this!
Flash-san is seriously not letting go!?"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
We've only completed 60% of the process.
I'm not leaving until I master the cutting edge.
It seems Eishin Flash has settled into the Academy quite well.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
! ...You're right.
Even though I learned at the inn that there's no need to rush.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...It seems I must once again
ingrain "wabi-sabi" within myself.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Wabi... W-Wasabi? Huh, what's that mean?
A few days later, Eishin Flash was seen meditating on campus together with Grass Wonder...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Inhaaaale... Exhaaale...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Looking good~.
Keep that up, and calm your mind even more...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Something will surely become clear along that path...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
...I feel it.
The wind, the earth... no, the entire world...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Ah...... This sensation... is truly magnificent.
It seems Eishin Flash has grown accustomed not just to Japan, but to the world as well...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ehh.
But won't it be bad if Mom calls?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"My parents are busy running their shop.
They won't be calling all that often."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! You're completely out of breath!
Flash-san, what's the matter!?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
N-No... I was just...
on the phone with my parents... that's all...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...Out of breath on the phone?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Since my parents don't understand Japanese,
I spent about three hours on a video call
communicating through gestures...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: T-Three hours?!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: ...I've learned that moderation is best.

From then on, Eishin Flash did her best to blend into Japan,
using a balanced mix of German and Japanese...
